name: Open-Source Fonts Repository Index
description: Comprehensive registry of verified open-source typography sources, API endpoints, download patterns, and licenses.

web_api.description: Returns full list of families, subsets, variants, and direct TTF file URLs.

fontsource_mirror_api.description: Free open REST API with full metadata, weights, styles, subsets, and direct CDN URLs.

github_metadata.description: Protobuf metadata in google/fonts repository containing designer, date, copyright, and file details.

direct_family_zip.format: ZIP archive containing TTF or OTF files and OFL.txt license file.

git_sparse_checkout.command: git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/google/fonts.git; cd fonts; git sparse-checkout set ofl/{family_name}

sources.name: Fontshare (Indian Type Foundry)
sources.license_note: Carefully filter by 'sil_ofl' license type if strict open-source redistribution/modification is needed. Fonts marked 'itf_ffl' are free for personal and commercial use but are proprietary freeware.

api.description: REST API returning typography metadata, designer biographies, styles, OpenType features, and license types.

direct_zip.format: ZIP archive with OTF, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2 font files.

notable_organizations.name: The League of Moveable Type
notable_organizations.description: The first open-source font foundry. Pioneer of decentralized open typography.

notable_organizations.name: Velvetyne Type Foundry (VTF)
notable_organizations.description: French collective designing open-source experimental and display typography.

notable_organizations.name: Collletttivo
notable_organizations.description: Open-source type design collective promoting libre type design and education.

notable_organizations.name: Adobe Fonts Open Source
notable_organizations.description: Adobe Source Sans 3, Source Code Pro, Source Serif 4, Source Han Sans (CJK).

notable_organizations.name: IBM Plex
notable_organizations.description: IBM's official open-source corporate superfamily (Sans, Serif, Mono, Arabic, Thai, Math).

notable_organizations.name: GitHub Next & Brand
notable_organizations.description: Mona Sans & Hubot Sans variable font families.
